content.short: The platform for peer-to-peer for raising funds for a business idea that needs to be kickstarted or a charitable cause.
content.description:
Cardano’s go-to platform for peer to peer fundraising whether that be for raising funds for a business idea that needs to be kickstarted or a charitable cause.

Adafund.me is a crowdfunding platform built with Cardano in mind so users can raise funds for new ideas or charitable causes. All users have to do is simply login in and use our form to create a fund. Once a fund has been vetted by our staff members it will be displayed to our users and others in the Cardano community will be able to donate towards it.
